verdict.rationale: GitHub's docs generically mention organizing issues, roadmaps and tasks (github-docs-8, github-docs-12), which covers milestones and basic issue tracking, but there is no evidence pack support for native time tracking (a capability GitHub has traditionally lacked, requiring third-party apps) or explicit dependency-tracking features. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of time tracking on issues, explicit documentation of issue dependency/blocking relationships, and any independent corroboration of these specific capabilities.
